```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '/fh/fast/sun_w/yub/tcr/tracerx/tcr-seq')
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(pbmcapply)
```

## Load meta data

```{r Load meta data}
meta = as_tibble(data.table::fread('SraRunTable.csv'))
meta = tibble(
  file_id = meta[['Run']], 
  sample_name = meta[['Sample Name']], 
  tissue = meta[['tissue']]
)
meta$tumor = sapply(strsplit(meta$sample_name, '_'), head, n = 1)
table(meta$tissue)
spacer = readRDS('spacer.rds')
```

## Load TCR

```{r}
load_decombinator_result <- function(tsv) {
  raw <- as_tibble(data.table::fread(tsv))
  chain <- ifelse(grepl("_alpha\\.tsv$", tsv, ignore.case = TRUE), "A", "B")
  raw |>
    filter(productive == "T") |>
    select(
      cdr3_aa  = junction_aa,
      cdr3_nt  = junction,
      V        = v_call,
      J        = j_call,
      count    = duplicate_count
    ) |>
    group_by(cdr3_aa) |>          # Merge CDR3 counts from different V, J genes
    summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(chain = chain)
}
```

```{r Load Decombinator results}
decombinator_files = as.vector(unlist(plyr::alply(spacer, 1, function(x) {
  folder = ifelse(x$spacer == 'i8', 'decombinator_results_I8', 'decombinator_results_M13')
  file.path(folder, x$file)
})))
tcr = Reduce(rbind, pbmcmapply(function(file) {
  data = load_decombinator_result(file)
  file_id = strsplit(file, '_')[[1]][4]
  sample_name = meta$sample_name[match(file_id, meta$file_id)]
  tumor = strsplit(sample_name, '_')[[1]][1]
  tibble(tumor = tumor, file_id = file_id, sample_name = sample_name, data)
}, decombinator_files, SIMPLIFY = F, mc.cores = 30))
tcr$tissue = meta$tissue[match(tcr$file_id, meta$file_id)]
# Distinguish same AA sequences from different chains
tcr$tcr_id = paste0(tcr$cdr3_aa, '_', tcr$chain)
```

## QC

```{r}
# AA sequnce compositions
table(unlist(strsplit(tcr$cdr3_aa, '')))
# Length of AA sequences
table(nchar(tcr$cdr3_aa))
tcr = tcr |> filter(nchar(cdr3_aa) >= 5)
```

## Summary

```{r}
# Number of tumors
length(unique(tcr$tumor))
# Number of alpha chain TCRs
length(unique(tcr$cdr3_aa[tcr$chain == 'A']))
# Number of beta chain TCRs
length(unique(tcr$cdr3_aa[tcr$chain == 'B']))
```

```{r}
# Number of tumors per TCR
plot_data = tcr |> 
  group_by(cdr3_aa, chain) |> 
  summarise(ntumor = length(unique(tumor)), .groups = 'drop')
ggplot(plot_data, aes(ntumor, fill = chain)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = log10(after_stat(count))), position = position_stack(), binwidth = 1) +
  labs(fill = '', x = 'Number of tumors per TCR', y = 'log10(count)') +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(breaks = c('A', 'B'), labels = c('alpha chain', 'beta chain')) +
  theme_pubr()
```

```{r}
# TCR frequency
plot_data = tcr |> 
  group_by(cdr3_aa, chain) |> 
  summarise(freq = sum(count), .groups = 'drop')
ggplot(plot_data, aes(freq, fill = chain)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_histogram(position = position_stack()) +
  labs(fill = '', x = 'TCR frequency') +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(breaks = c('A', 'B'), labels = c('alpha chain', 'beta chain')) +
  theme_pubr()
```

```{r}
# Number of TCRs per tumor
plot_data = tcr |>

ggplot(plot_data, aes(ntcr, fill = chain)) +

  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = 'Number of TCRs per tumor', fill = '') +

```

```{r}
# Number of unique TCRs per tumor
plot_data = tcr |> 
  group_by(tumor, chain) |> 
  summarise(ntcr = length(unique(cdr3_aa)), .groups = 'drop')
ggplot(plot_data, aes(ntcr, fill = chain)) +
  geom_histogram(position = position_stack()) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(color = '', x = 'Number of unique TCRs per tumor') +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(breaks = c('A', 'B'), labels = c('alpha chain', 'beta chain')) +

```

## Build TCR matrix: only tumors

```{r Build TCR matrix: only tumors}
tcr_tumor = tcr |> 
  filter(tissue == 'Lung tumour') |>
  group_by(tumor, tcr_id) |>
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = 'drop')
tumors = sort(unique(tcr_tumor$tumor))
tcrs = sort(unique(tcr_tumor$tcr_id))
mat_tumor = Matrix::sparseMatrix(
  i = match(tcr_tumor$tumor, tumors),
  j = match(tcr_tumor$tcr_id, tcrs),
  x = tcr_tumor$count,
  dims = c(length(tumors), length(tcrs)),
  dimnames = list(tumors, tcrs)
)
dim(mat_tumor)
```

## Build TCR matrix: including blood

```{r Build TCR matrix: including blood}
tcr_blood = tcr |> 
  filter(tissue %in% c('Lung tumour', 'Blood')) |>
  group_by(tumor, tcr_id) |>
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = 'drop')
tumors = sort(unique(tcr_blood$tumor))
tcrs = sort(unique(tcr_blood$tcr_id))
mat_blood = Matrix::sparseMatrix(
  i = match(tcr_blood$tumor, tumors),
  j = match(tcr_blood$tcr_id, tcrs),
  x = tcr_blood$count,
  dims = c(length(tumors), length(tcrs)),
  dimnames = list(tumors, tcrs)
)
dim(mat_blood)
```

## Save

```{r}
saveRDS(tcr, file = 'df_tcr.rds')
saveRDS(mat_tumor, file = 'mat_tcr_tumor.rds')
saveRDS(mat_blood, file = 'mat_tcr_tumor_blood.rds')
sessionInfo()
```
